The original: NIFTY 50 market filter, 0.5R time stop
notes: Entry: monthly StochRSI pullback; close above EMA 61 on monthly, weekly and daily; RSI above 50; NIFTY 500 index above its 200-day average (previous close).
Exits: stop at the previous week's low; sell at the next open if the trade is not 0.25R up 25 days after entry; otherwise hold until the weekly Supertrend(10, 3) turns bearish. No holding cap.
Sizing: 1% risk per trade on current equity, 10 slots, 20% position cap; halve size at a 10% drawdown, pause 21 days at 15%. Idle cash in a liquid fund. No NIFTY futures hedges.
The worst drawdown (May–June 2006 crash) can't be cut by an entry filter; plan for about −27% to −30%.
